preconditions.description: The number of necklace parts n must be between 1 and 500,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a < 2**20 and 0 <= b < 2**20 for a, b in parts)
preconditions.description: Each pearl color a and b must be a non-negative integer less than 2^20.
The number of provided necklace parts must match the specified n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the maximum beauty b followed by the indices of pearls in the correct order.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= 2*n for p_i in p)
postconditions.description: All pearl indices in the output must be within the range from 1 to 2n.
The output must contain exactly 2n distinct pearl indices.
